title: oenothera pallida var. runcinata
intro: Oenothera pallida var. runcinata, commonly known as the Western evening primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera pallida var. runcinata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
